MIT 3.071 Amorphous Materials, Spring 2025
Instructor: Juejun Hu
This lecture covers optical fiber design, including total internal reflection, light confinement, fiber drawing, preform fabrication (MCVD), multimode/single-mode fibers, microstructured fibers, and planar waveguide techniques for integrated photonics.
